blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Recent advances in Omni Language Models (OLMs) provide a unified solution for audiovisual video captioning. Nevertheless, existing approaches predominantly treat captioning as an unstructured text generation process, neglecting the inherent semantic structure of videos and leading to suboptimal fine-grained audiovisual alignment. To bridge this gap, we propose EVA-Cap, a novel framework that decomposes captions into atomic audiovisual events and transforms unstructured text supervision into event-centric alignment. We train EVA-Cap via Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) on a self-curated dataset, EVA-Data, which is built with event-centric quality control. During the GRPO phase, the model is explicitly optimized against three event-centric alignment targets: global event completeness, intra-event attribution, and inter-event synchronization. Extensive experiments demonstrate that EVA-Cap significantly outperforms existing methods in event-centric evaluation (e.g., +9.0% average gain on ChronusAV), while achieving competitive performance on general audiovisual captioning benchmarks (e.g., +3.3% on WorldSense).
blocks.zh: 近期在Omni语言模型(OLM)方面的进展为视听视频字幕提供了统一解决方案. 然而,现有办法主要将标题视为一种结构不合理的文本生成过程,忽视了视频固有的语义结构,导致优劣的精细音频对接。 为了弥补这一差距,我们提议EVA-Cap,这是一个将标题分解为原子视听事件并把无结构文本监督转变为以事件为中心的对齐的新框架。 我们通过监督精选(SFT)和集团相对政策优化(GRPO)在自定义的数据集EVA-Data上进行EVA-Cap培训,该数据集以事件为中心进行质量控制. 在GRPO阶段,该模式根据三个以事件为中心的对接目标被明确优化:全球事件完整性,事件内部归属,以及事件间同步. 广泛的实验表明,EVA-Cap在以事件为中心的评价方面大大超过现有方法(例如,ChronusAV的平均增益为9.0%),同时在一般视听字幕基准方面(例如,WorldSense为+3.3%)取得了竞争力。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Video captioning [ 3 , 13 , 37 , 61 , 48 ] aims to extract rich semantic content from videos and generate coherent natural language descriptions.
As a fundamental task in video understanding, it underpins various downstream applications, including video retrieval [ 39 , 47 , 57 , 34 ] , video reasoning [ 38 , 11 , 56 , 10 , 28 ] , and video generation [ 2 , 40 , 54 , 36 , 35 ] .
Recently, advances in Transformer-based end-to-end models have revolutionized the conventional modularized video caption pipelines.
Especially, Omni Language Models (OLMs) [ 29 , 20 , 53 , 46 , 52 , 7 ] have driven a paradigm shift from visual-only modeling to an omni-modal paradigm that integrates audio and visual signals, enabling more effective cross-modal reasoning and stronger generalization in real-world audiovisual scenarios.
blocks.zh:
视频字幕[3,13,37,61,48]旨在从视频中提取丰富的语义内容,并生成连贯的自然语言描述.
作为视频理解的一项基本任务,它支撑了各种下游应用,包括视频检索[39,47,57,34],视频推理[38,11,56,10,28],视频生成[2,40,54,36,35].
最近,基于变形器的端对端模型的进步使传统的模块化视频字幕管道发生了革命性的变化.
尤其是Omni语言模型(OLMs)[29,20,53,46,52,7]推动了一种范式的转变,从只以视觉为主的模型到融合音频和视觉信号的全能模式,使得跨模式推理更加有效,在现实世界的视听情景中更加普及.

blocks.en:
Despite its promise, achieving factually accurate and comprehensive audiovisual captioning remains difficult due to the intrinsic complexity and dense interdependence between visual and auditory content.
Existing methods treat video captioning as a text generation problem for OLMs based on caption-level supervision [ 4 , 43 ] .
This overlooks the structured semantics inherent in videos, meaning a generated caption may be linguistically correct but misaligned with the logical structure and event-level correspondences.
While some recent research has incorporated additional supervision over specific aspects (e.g., dialogue [ 5 , 30 ] or object attributes [ 19 , 6 ] ), such narrowly scoped supervision still struggles to achieve fine-grained audiovisual alignment.
Consequently, a critical bottleneck stems from the lack of an effective caption representation that unifies video-grounded structural semantics with general language modeling.
blocks.zh:
尽管它有希望,但由于视觉内容和听觉内容之间的内在复杂性和密切的相互依存性,实现实实在在的准确和全面的视听字幕仍然是困难的。
现有方法将视频字幕视为基于字幕级别监管的OLM的文本生成问题[4,43].
这忽略了视频中固有的结构化语义,意思是生成的字幕在语言上可能正确,但与逻辑结构和事件级对应错误.
虽然最近的一些研究增加了对具体方面的监督(例如对话[5、30]或对象属性[19、6]),但这种范围狭窄的监督仍然难以实现精细的视听协调。
因此,一个关键的瓶颈是缺乏有效的标题说明,无法将基于视频的结构语义与一般语言模型统一起来。

blocks.en:
To address this issue, we propose framing video captioning as assembling discrete, atomic audiovisual event sequences through joint optimization of event content and their correspondences.
As illustrated in Fig. 1 , a video consists of multiple audio and visual events, where each event is represented as a tuple of type, character, and content.
These events can be aligned temporally to form a coherent caption clip, linked via shared semantic content and explicit synchronous connectors (e.g., “as”, “at the same time”).
Crucially, such an event-centric perspective bridges audiovisual events and captions by modeling both intra-event attribution (i.e., whether the attributions of a single event are correct?) and inter-event synchronization (i.e., what are the temporal order and synchronization of different events?).
While such an event-centric perspective provides a structured semantic understanding of videos beyond mere language modeling, effectively integrating such insights into OLMs post-training remains an open question.
This gap is largely due to (1) the scarcity of high-quality audiovisual caption data with event-level fidelity, and (2) the absence of dedicated event-centric frameworks for leveraging supervision with event-level heuristics.
blocks.zh:
为了解决这一问题,我们提议通过共同优化事件内容及其对应材料,将视频字幕设定为集散的原子视听事件序列。
如图1所示,一个视频包含多个音频和视觉事件,其中每个事件都以类型,性格,和内容的翻转为代表.
这些事件可以暂时调整,形成一个连贯的字幕片段,通过共享语义内容和明确的同步连接器(例如“as”,“同时”)连接起来。
重要的是,这种以事件为中心的视角通过模拟事件内部归属(即单一事件的归属是否正确? )和事件间同步(即不同事件的时间顺序和同步性是什么? )来连接视听事件和标题.
虽然这种以事件为中心的视角提供了对视频的结构化语义理解,而不仅仅是语言建模,但将这种见解有效纳入手语LMs培训后仍是一个未决问题。
这一差距主要是由于(1) 缺乏具有事件层面忠诚度的高质量视听字幕数据,以及(2) 缺乏以事件为中心的专门框架来利用事件层面的热度来进行监督。

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Illustration of the event-centric representation of audiovisual captions, where aligned audiovisual events are composed into the predicted caption.
blocks.zh: 图1:以事件为中心的视听字幕说明,其中对齐的视听活动构成预测字幕。

blocks.en:
To this end, we propose EVA-Cap, which builds upon Qwen2.5-Omni [ 45 ] and unifies event-centric alignment within the language modeling post-training phase.
Specifically, we first construct EVA-Data, a 63K audiovisual video–caption dataset, via an automatic initialization–refinement pipeline followed by event-centric quality control.
In this process, timestamped audiovisual events are extracted from raw videos and subjected to per-event verification to ensure high fidelity.
Furthermore, we introduce a two-stage post-training strategy to facilitate event-centric alignment, which consists of SFT ( SFT ) and GRPO ( GRPO ) [ 27 ] on the EVA-Data.
During the GRPO stage, three event-centric rewards are designed to enforce global completeness (via event recall), intra-event attribution (via character matching), and inter-event synchronization (via cross-modal retrieval).
Collectively, these post-training objectives enhance the fine-grained alignment of audiovisual events, enabling factually accurate, event-grounded audiovisual caption generation.
blocks.zh:
为此,我们提出EVA-Cap,它以Qun2.5-Omni[45]为基础,并在培训后阶段的语文模型中统一以事件为中心的统一。
具体地说,我们首先通过自动初始化的精炼管道,然后进行以事件为中心的质量控制,建造了EVA-Data,即一个63K视听录像-封装数据集。
在这一过程中,从原始录像中提取时间戳的视听活动,并进行每项活动的核查,以确保高度忠实。
此外,我们推出了一个两阶段的培训后战略,以促进以事件为中心的协调,该战略包括EVA-数据上的SFT(SFT)和GPRO(GPRO)[27]。
在GRPO阶段,有三个以事件为中心的奖励旨在(通过事件召回),事件内部归属(通过字符匹配),以及事件间同步(通过跨模式检索)实现全球完整性.
集体而言,这些培训后目标加强了视听活动的精细协调,从而能够产生事实准确、基于事件的视听字幕。

blocks.en:
Extensive experiments demonstrate that EVA-Cap outperforms existing open-source models across 6 audiovisual benchmarks.
For example, on general captioning benchmarks, EVA-Cap achieves a total error rate of 34.6% on video-SALMONN-2 testset [ 29 ] and surpasses existing methods by a clear margin of 3.3% on WorldSense [ 15 ] .
Most importantly, on event-centric evaluation with ChronusAV [ 7 ] and AV-SpeakerBench [ 23 ] , EVA-Cap exhibits substantial advantages with an accuracy of 55.4%, 56.2%, and 40.1% for Visual-to-Audio (V2A) inference, Audio-to-Visual (A2V) grounding, and speaker attribution, respectively.
These results underscore the capability of EVA-Cap in generating highly faithful captions with precise temporal alignment and accurate event attribution.
blocks.zh:
广泛的实验表明,EVA-Cap在6个视听基准上超越了现有的开放源码模型。
例如,在一般标题基准上,EVA-Cap在视频-SALMONN-2测试集上的总误差率为34.6%[29],在WorldSense[15]上以3.3%的明显差值超过了现有方法.
最重要的是,在与ChronusAV[7]和AV-Speaker Bench[23]进行的以事件为中心的评价中,EVA-Cap表现出了巨大的优势,其精度分别为55.4%、56.2%和40.1%,分别用于Visual to-Audio(V2A)推论、A2V)对Visual(A2V)的地面定位和演讲者归属。
这些结果突出表明,EVA-Cap有能力制作具有精确时间调整和准确事件归属的高度忠实的标题。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Audiovisual Video Captioning.
blocks.zh: 2.1 视听录像字幕。

blocks.en: Recent advancements in Omni Language Models (OLMs) [ 29 , 20 , 53 , 46 ] have significantly improved multimodal perception in complex real-world scenarios, thereby promoting the development of audiovisual captioning [ 21 , 12 , 18 ] . However, existing approaches remain constrained by the scarcity of high-quality audiovisual caption data, and largely rely on either coarse-grained supervision or focus on limited aspects of the task. For instance, AVoCaDO [ 4 ] constructs large-scale audiovisual video-caption pairs through temporal orchestration, but suffers from insufficient factual verification and coarse-grained temporal alignment. UGC-Captioner [ 43 ] relies on holistic caption-level supervision, whereas DiaDem [ 5 ] and D-ORCA [ 30 ] focus narrowly on specific aspects of captions, failing to capture fine-grained event-level correspondences. In contrast, we introduce an event-centric perspective for audiovisual captioning. We construct an event-enhanced dataset with event-centric quality control, and propose an event-centric training strategy that explicitly models event-level alignment, enabling accurate and event-grounded audiovisual caption generation.
blocks.zh: 近期在Omni语言模型[29、20、53、46]方面的进步大大提高了复杂现实世界情景中的多式联运观念,从而促进了视听标题[21、12、18]的发展。 然而,由于缺乏高质量的视听字幕数据,现有办法仍然受到限制,主要依靠粗糙的监督或专注于任务的有限方面。 例如,AVoCaDO[4]通过时空协调构筑了大型视听视频封装对,但受到事实核实不足和粗糙的时间调整的影响。 UGC-Capitioner [43] 依赖于整体标题级别监督,而DiaDem [5] 和D-ORCA [30] 则狭隘地关注标题的特定方面,未能捕捉到细微的事件级别对应. 相反,我们对视听字幕采用了以事件为中心的视角。 我们用以事件为中心的质量控制构建一个增强事件数据集,并提议以事件为中心的培训战略,明确模拟事件层面的对齐,从而能够生成准确和以事件为基础的视听字幕。

blocks.en: 2.2 Reinforcement Learning for Visual Content Captioning.
blocks.zh: 2.2 视觉内容说明强化学习。

blocks.en: Reinforcement learning [ 27 , 55 , 60 ] plays an increasingly important role in caption optimization, spanning from visual-only to omni-modal scenarios. CapRL [ 44 ] and RubiCap [ 16 ] design verifiable rubrics for dense image captioning. OwlCap [ 61 ] and VideoCap-R1 [ 22 ] improve video captioning by matching key information extracted from visual content. In the audiovisual domain, D-ORCA [ 30 ] introduces dialogue-oriented rewards focusing on speaker and ASR consistency, while TimeChat-Captioner [ 51 ] optimizes timestamp alignment under structured caption formats. However, these approaches typically focus on limited aspects and struggle to achieve fine-grained audiovisual alignment. In this paper, we develop three event-centric rewards that jointly enforce fine-grained supervision within and across modalities. This approach provides more precise event alignment than prior methods, which either focus on modality-specific objectives [ 30 , 5 ] or rely on coarse audiovisual synchronization [ 4 , 51 ] .
blocks.zh: 强化学习[27、55、60]在标题优化方面发挥着越来越重要的作用,从仅视觉模式到全方位模式。 CapRL [44] 和 RubiCap [16] 为密集的图像标题设计可核查的编号 。 猫头鹰[61]和VideoCap-R1[22]通过匹配从视觉内容中提取的关键信息来改进视频字幕. 在视听领域,D-ORCA[30]引入了面向对话的奖励,侧重于扬声器和ASR的一致性,而TimeChat-Captioner[51]则在结构化标题格式下优化了时间戳的对齐. 然而,这些办法通常侧重于有限的方面,并努力实现精细的视听协调。 在本文中,我们制定了三个以事件为中心的奖励办法,在模式内和模式间共同实施精细的监督。 这种方法比以前的方法更准确地提供了事件协调,这些方法要么侧重于特定模式的目标[30、5],要么依赖粗糙的视听同步[4、51]。

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en:
This section introduces the construction of EVA-Cap, which is built upon Qwen-2.5-Omni [ 45 ] and optimized for audiovisual video captioning via event-centric alignment.
First, we address the scarcity of high-quality data by curating EVA-Data, a 63K-scale audiovisual captioning dataset.
The dataset is generated using an automated pipeline with rigorous event-centric quality control (Sec. 3.1 ).
Next, we introduce a two-stage training strategy comprising SFT and GRPO to improve EVA-Cap with event-centric alignment.
The training process integrates a suite of event-centric rewards to effectively exploit event-level supervision (Sec. 3.2 ).
blocks.zh:
本节介绍EVA-Cap的构造,它以Quen-2.5-Omni[45]为基础,通过以事件为中心的对齐方式优化视听视频字幕.
首先,我们通过管理EVA-Data这一63K级的视听字幕数据集来解决高质量数据的稀缺问题。
数据集使用自动管道生成,该管道具有严格的以事件为中心的质量控制(第3.1节)。
接下来,我们推出一个由SFT和GPRO组成的两阶段培训战略,以以事件为中心,改进EVA-Cap。
培训过程纳入了一套以事件为中心的奖励办法,以有效地利用事件一级的监督(第3.2条)。

blocks.en: 3.1 EVA-Data Construction
blocks.zh: 3.1 EVA-数据建设

blocks.en: 3.1.1 Annotation Pipeline
blocks.zh: 3.1.1 注解管道

blocks.en: We develop an automatic annotation pipeline to construct audiovisual video–caption pairs with event-level fidelity. As shown in Fig. 2 , the pipeline comprises three main stages:
blocks.zh: 我们开发一个自动注释管道, 来构建视听视频, 如图2所示,管道包括三个主要阶段:

blocks.en: Stage 1: Initialization. We first utilize the open-source audiovisual captioner AVoCaDO [ 4 ] , which excels in holistic perception, to generate initial audiovisual descriptions for raw videos. This provides a coherent narrative of each video and captures key events and details, covering scene backgrounds, interactive actions, and audio transcriptions. We then filter out samples with repetitive descriptions or abnormal text lengths.
blocks.zh: 第一阶段:初始化。 我们首先利用开放源码的视听字幕AVoCaDO[4],该字幕在整体认知方面非常出色,为原始视频制作初步视听描述。 这为每段视频提供了连贯的叙述,并捕捉关键事件和细节,涵盖场景背景,互动行动,以及录音抄录. 然后用重复描述或异常文本长度过滤样本。

blocks.en: Stage 2: Refinement. We then feed both raw videos and initial descriptions to the advanced omni-model Gemini-2.5-Pro [ 8 ] for content refinement and temporal alignment. Guided by raw audiovisual signals, we instruct the model to strengthen the temporal synchronization of audiovisual events and revise event character attribution, while preserving the original natural language style. This yields refined descriptions with precise audiovisual event alignment, achieving fine-grained annotation.
blocks.zh: 阶段2:完善. 然后,我们把原始视频和初步描述都输入到高级的OMNI模型双子座2.5-Pro[8]中,用于内容的完善和时间的调整. 在原始视听信号的指导下,我们指示该模式加强视听事件的时间同步,修订事件特征归属,同时保留原始自然语言风格. 这产生了精确的视听事件描述,实现了精细的说明。

blocks.en: Stage 3: Event-Centric Quality Control. To ensure the quality of the curated data, we introduce an aligned event hit mechanism for the automatic validation of refined descriptions. Specifically, we employ Gemini-2.5-Pro to extract timestamp-grounded audiovisual event tuples directly from raw videos. We then input all event tuples together with refined descriptions to GPT-4.1 [ 1 ] to verify whether each event tuple is hit in the caption. An event hit requires both audio and visual events to be entailed with consistent temporal synchronization. This process jointly assesses the accuracy of audiovisual synchronization and event attribution in captions. We discard samples with an event hit ratio below a threshold of 0.8. In this way, we build a large-scale audiovisual caption dataset, EVA-Data, which provides high-quality event-level supervision for event-centric post-training.
blocks.zh: 第3阶段:事故-儿科质量控制。 为了确保整理数据的质量,我们引入了一种对齐的事件命中机制,用于自动验证精细描述. 具体来说,我们利用双子座2.5-Pro直接从原始视频中提取时间戳的视听事件拖拉。 然后,我们输入所有事件Tuple以及精细的描述给GPT-4.1 [1],以核实每个事件Tuple是否在标题中被击中. 事件命中要求音频和视觉事件都具有持续的时间同步性。 这一过程共同评估了视听同步和事件归属在标题中的准确性。 我们丢弃样本,事件命中率低于0.8阈值。 通过这种方式,我们建立了一个大型视听字幕数据集EVA-Data,为以事件为中心的培训后提供高质量的事件层面监督。

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Illustration of the designed data annotation pipeline, comprising three stages: initialization, refinement and event-centric quality control. Raw videos are transformed into audiovisual captions with high-fidelity audiovisual synchronization and event attributions.
blocks.zh: 图2:设计的数据注释管道图解,包含三个阶段:初始化,完善和以事件为中心的质量控制. 原始视频被转换成具有高度真实性视听同步和事件属性的视听字幕.

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Statistics of EVA-Data. (a) Video category distribution and (b) Video duration distribution demonstrate the diversity of this dataset, while (c) Event count distribution shows comparable counts of audio and visual events, indicating no modality bias in annotated captions.
blocks.zh: 图3:EVA-Data的统计。 (a) 视频类分布和(b) 视频持续时间分布显示这一数据集的多样性,而(c) 事件计数分布显示音频和视觉事件的可比数量,表明附加说明标题中没有模式偏差。

blocks.en: 3.1.2 Data Statistics
blocks.zh: 3.1.2 国家 数据统计

blocks.en: To guarantee both diversity and quality, we collect 100K audiovisual videos (each under 200 seconds in duration) from LLaVA-Video [ 58 ] , FineVideo [ 9 ] , and Shot2Story [ 14 ] . Through the annotation pipeline, EVA-Data ultimately yields 63K audiovisual video-caption pairs with event-level fidelity. Fig. 3 (b) illustrates the duration distribution of these videos. On average, each video lasts 73.7 seconds, while the corresponding captions average 504.3 words. We further randomly sample 20K videos from EVA-Data and analyze the distribution of audio and visual events in the corresponding captions, as shown in Fig. 3 (c). The results demonstrate that the annotated videos contain rich audiovisual information and the captions are free of modality bias, thus providing effective supervision for event-centric alignment.
blocks.zh: 为了保证多样性和质量,我们从LLaVA-Video[58]、FineVideo[9]和Shot2 Story[14]收集了100K个视听录像(每个录像时间不到200秒)。 通过注解管道,EVA-Data最终产生6,300K的视频封装对,具有事件层面的忠诚. 图3(b)说明了这些视频的持续时间。 每段视频平均持续时间73.7秒,而相应的字幕平均为504.3字. 如图3(c)所示,我们进一步随机抽取EVA-Data的20K视频,并分析相应标题中的音频和视觉事件分布情况。 结果显示,附加说明的视频包含丰富的视听信息,标题没有模式偏差,从而对以事件为中心的调整提供了有效的监督。

blocks.en: 3.2 Post-Training of EVA-Cap
blocks.zh: 3.2 EVA-Cap培训后

blocks.en: Leveraging this dataset, we propose EVA-Cap, an audiovisual captioner optimized via event-centric alignment. We first present our two-stage training pipeline in Sec. 3.2.1 , and then introduce the event-centric reward functions dedicated to fine-grained alignment in Sec. 3.2.2 .
blocks.zh: 利用这个数据集,我们提出EVA-Cap,一个通过以事件为中心的对齐而优化的视听字幕器. 我们首先在3.2.1 Sec介绍我们两个阶段的培训管道,然后在3.2.2 Sec介绍以事件为中心的奖励功能,专门用于精细调整。

blocks.en: 3.2.1 Training Pipeline
blocks.zh: 3.2.1 培训管道

blocks.en: We build EVA-Cap upon the Qwen2.5-Omni Thinker module, which jointly encodes audio and video into a unified, temporally interleaved token sequence to facilitate synchronous audiovisual understanding. We then adopt a two-stage post-training pipeline consisting of supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO).
blocks.zh: 我们在Quen2.5-Omni Thinker模块上构建了EVA-Cap,该模块将音频和视频共同编码成一个统一的、按时间间隔的符号序列,以促进同步的视听理解。 然后,我们采用一个两阶段培训后管道,包括监督微调和集团相对政策优化。

blocks.en:
In the first phase, we perform SFT on our constructed 63K EVA-Data to empower the model to generate detailed captions that integrate both audio and visual modalities.
In the second phase, we further optimize the SFT model with GRPO on 3.2K rollout videos from EVA-Data (details of the rollout process are provided in Appendix A.2.2 ).
To enhance fine-grained alignment in audiovisual captions, we design event-centric rewards covering three dimensions: event completeness, character attribution, and audiovisual synchronization.
The detailed SFT and GRPO objectives are provided in Appendix A.1 , and the reward design is elaborated in Sec. 3.2.2 .
blocks.zh:
在第一阶段,我们用我们建造的63K EVA-Data进行SFT,赋予该模型以生成详细标题的能力,这些标题既包括音频模式,也包括视觉模式。
在第二阶段,我们在EVA-Data的3.2K推出视频上与GRPO进一步优化了SFT模式(推出过程详情见附录A.2.2.)。
为加强视听字幕的精细调整,我们设计了以事件为中心的奖励,涵盖三个层面:事件完整性、人物归属和视听同步。
详细的SFT和GPRO目标载于附录A.1,奖励设计载于第3.2.2节。

During training, we adopt this reward with two rounds of GRPO to achieve progressive alignment.
Specifically, in the first round, we set λ comp \lambda_{\mathrm{comp}} and λ sync \lambda_{\mathrm{sync}} to 1 while setting λ attr \lambda_{\mathrm{attr}} to 0.
In the second round, we set all three coefficients to 1.
The process transitions from global coarse-grained event alignment and audiovisual synchronization to fine-grained character-level attribution.

Performance on direct quality assessment. We evaluate EVA-Cap on two representative general audiovisual captioning benchmarks.
Those benchmarks assess the overall captioning performance from multiple dimensions, including video content omission, hallucination, and multi-aspect scoring.
The comparison with existing audiovisual models is presented in Tab. 1 .

In Tab. 4 , we conduct ablation experiments to study the effects of our post-training pipeline and reward suite.
First, the baseline Qwen2.5-Omni suffers from inherent modality bias [ 26 ] , where audio content is frequently omitted in its generated captions, resulting in poor performance across all tasks.
After SFT on our constructed EVA-Data, the model achieves considerable improvements in both general audiovisual captioning and event alignment, e.g., the V2A and A2V accuracy increases from 8.4% to 44.8% and from 11.9% to 46.1%, respectively.

blocks.en:
We further investigate the effects of three event-centric rewards during the GRPO phase.
The global event completeness reward ℛ comp \mathcal{R}_{\mathrm{comp}} penalizes event omission, thereby boosting model performance across all dimensions (+8.5%, +2.1%, and +3.7% accuracy on V2A, AV-Speaker, and Daily-Omni).
Furthermore, integrating the inter-event synchronization reward ℛ sync \mathcal{R}_{\mathrm{sync}} and intra-event attribution reward ℛ attr \mathcal{R}_{\mathrm{attr}} yields consistent gains on corresponding tasks (+2.1% on A2V and +3.1% on AV-Speaker in terms of accuracy), while also improving the overall captioning performance steadily.
Collectively, these three rewards enable precise alignment in both event content and event correspondence, facilitating factually accurate, event-grounded audiovisual video captioning.
blocks.zh:
我们进一步调查在GRPO阶段三项以事件为中心的奖励的效果。
全球事件完整性奖励 R comp \ mathcal{ R}_{\ mathrm{ comp} 惩罚事件遗漏, 从而提升所有层面的模型性能( +8. 5%, + 2. 1%, 和 V2A、 AV- Speaker 和 Daily-Omni 的 + 3. 7%) 。
此外,将事件间同步奖励R同步\ mathcal{R}_{\ mathrm{sync}和事件内归属奖励R attr\mathcal{R}_{\ mathrm{atr}}}结合起来,在相应的任务上产生一致的收益(在准确性方面,A2V上为+2.1%,AV-Speaker上为+3.1%),同时也稳步改善总体字幕性能.
这三个奖项合在一起,使事件内容和事件函证都能够准确一致,便于事实准确、基于事件的视听录像字幕。

blocks.en: To further dissect our two-stage GRPO design, we conduct additional ablations. Introducing attribution reward ℛ attr \mathcal{R}_{\mathrm{attr}} as early as the first round not only compromises general performance but also degrades event-centric alignment. We hypothesize that injecting both ℛ sync \mathcal{R}_{\mathrm{sync}} and ℛ attr \mathcal{R}_{\mathrm{attr}} prematurely leads to optimization conflicts between inter-event relations and intra-event accuracy. Conversely, a progressive strategy facilitates a gradual alignment process, from global coarse-grained structures to fine-grained character-level details. Moreover, comparisons against a baseline that sustains only ℛ comp \mathcal{R}_{\mathrm{comp}} and ℛ sync \mathcal{R}_{\mathrm{sync}} in the second round demonstrate that the sustained improvements stem from effective reward design rather than mere data scaling.
blocks.zh: 为了进一步解析我们两阶段的GRPO设计,我们进行了更多的喷发. 引入归属奖励 R attr \ mathcal{ R}_{\ mathrm{ attr}}} 早在第一轮不仅会损害一般性能,而且会降低事件中心对齐. 我们假设,R同步\ mathcal{R}_{\ mathrm{sync}和R attr\mathcal{R}_{\ mathrm{atr}的注射过早导致事件间关系和事件内准确性之间的冲突的优化。 反之,渐进战略有助于逐步调整进程,从全球粗糙结构到精细的品格级细节。 此外,与仅维持R comp\mathcal{R}_{\mathrm{comp}}和R同步\mathcal{R}_{\mathrm{sync}}的基线在第二轮中的比较表明,持续的改进来自有效的奖励设计,而不仅仅是数据缩放.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
This paper presents EVA-Cap, an audiovisual video captioning model with a training framework that transforms holistic caption optimization into event-centric alignment.
To support event-level supervision, we first constructed EVA-Data with event-centric quality control and adopted a two-stage post-training strategy with SFT and GRPO.
Then, by decomposing captions into modality-grounded events, EVA-Cap elaborates fine-grained GRPO rewards tailored to event completeness, character attribution, and audiovisual synchronization.
Extensive experiments demonstrate that SFT on EVA-Data significantly improves OLMs to internalize event-centric knowledge.
Furthermore, the subsequent GRPO optimization improves event-centric alignment while maintaining strong general captioning performance.
These results suggest that event-centric alignment offers an effective path toward more faithful and temporally coherent audiovisual video captioning.
blocks.zh:
本文介绍了EVA-Cap,这是一个具有培训框架的视听视频字幕模型,将整体字幕优化转化为以事件为中心的对齐。
为了支持活动一级的监督,我们首先建立了以活动为中心的质量控制的EVA-Data,并与SFT和GPRO一起通过了两个阶段的培训后战略。
然后,EVA-Cap通过将标题分解成基于模式的事件,详细规定了针对事件完整性、性格归属和视听同步的精细的GRPO奖励。
广泛的实验表明,EVA-Data上的SFT大大改进了OLM,使以事件为中心的知识内部化.
此外,随后的GRPO优化改进了以事件为中心的对齐,同时保持了强大的一般标题性能.
这些结果表明,以事件为中心的调整为更加忠实和时间上一致的视听录像字幕提供了一个有效途径。

blocks.en: A.2 More Implementation Details
blocks.zh: A.2 更多执行 细节

blocks.en: A.2.1 Details about the Construction of Reference Structures
blocks.zh: A.2.1 (中文(简体) ). 关于构建参考结构的细节

blocks.en: We filter 6.4K videos from EVA-Data, all of which achieve a 100% hit ratio in Stage 3 of the annotation pipeline, ensuring highly accurate event-level supervision signals. To facilitate efficient reward computation for both GRPO training and rollout, we construct reference structures for these 6.4K selected videos. Specifically, this involves extracting audiovisual event units ℰ ⋆ \mathcal{E}^{\star} from the ground-truth captions y ⋆ y^{\star} and formulating audio-to-visual synchronization queries 𝒬 ⋆ \mathcal{Q}^{\star} .
blocks.zh: 我们过滤了来自EVA-Data的6.4K视频,所有这些视频在注释管道的第三阶段中都实现了100%的命中率,确保了高度精确的事件级监督信号. 为了便于高效地计算GRPO培训和推出的奖励,我们为这些6.4K选定的视频构建了参考结构. 具体而言,这涉及从地面真实字幕中提取视听事件单位E \\ mathcal{ E}^{\star},以及制作音频到视频同步查询Q \ mathcal{Q}^{\star}。

blocks.en:
We employ the reward judge LLM, Qwen3.5-27B [ 33 ] , prompting it to sequentially extract audio events and visual events from the given caption to form a unified event list ℰ ⋆ \mathcal{E}^{\star} . Each extracted audio event serves as a separate query. We input the complete ground-truth caption along with all the extracted visual events into the LLM, prompting it to select the temporally synchronized visual events corresponding to the current audio event (i.e., the current query) from all the input visual events.
Each visual event is assigned a unique index based on its chronological extraction order (i.e., the first extracted visual event has an index of 1). Since all visual events are extracted sequentially, we discard audio events whose matched visual event index span exceeds 5.
This filtering step excludes audio events that cover an excessively long temporal range (e.g., background music that plays throughout the entire video), as such coarse-grained audio events provide limited support for fine-grained audiovisual alignment. Next, we construct a candidate visual event set containing 5 visual events by selecting those adjacent to the indices of the selected synchronized visual events. This strategy naturally incorporates neighboring visual events, which are prone to misalignment with the audio events—thereby creating challenging hard negative samples for subsequent reward assessment.
Collectively, the filtered audio events paired with their corresponding constructed visual candidate sets form the final synchronization queries 𝒬 ⋆ \mathcal{Q}^{\star} .
blocks.zh:
我们雇用了奖赏法官LLM, Quen3.5-27B[33], 促使它从给定的字幕中依次提取音频事件和视觉事件, 每个提取的音频事件都作为单独的查询. 我们将完整的地面真实字幕以及所有提取的视觉事件输入LLM,促使它从所有输入视觉事件中选择与当前音频事件(即当前查询)相对应的时间同步视觉事件.
每个视觉事件根据时间顺序分配一个独特的索引(即第一个提取的视觉事件有1个索引). 由于所有视觉事件都是按顺序提取的,我们放弃了相匹配的视觉事件索引跨度超过的音频事件.  5.五.
这一过滤步骤排除了覆盖过长时间范围的音频事件(例如在整个视频中播放的背景音乐),因为此类粗糙的音频事件为精细的音频对齐提供了有限的支持. 接下来,我们构建一个包含5个视觉事件的候选视觉事件集,通过选择与选定的同步视觉事件指数相邻的视觉事件. 这一策略自然包含了相邻的视觉事件,它们容易与音频事件错配,从而形成挑战性的硬反面样本,供随后的奖励评估.
集体地,过滤的音频事件与它们相应的构造的视觉候选集对齐,形成最终的同步查询Q Q \ mathcal{Q}^{\star}.

blocks.en: As a result, we obtain an audiovisual event unit set and an audio-to-visual synchronization query set for each video. These well-defined reference structures enable reliable event-level reward calculation and support the subsequent GRPO training pipeline.
blocks.zh: 因此,我们获得了一个视听事件单元和每个视频的视听同步查询集。 这些定义明确的参考结构能够可靠地计算出事件一级的奖励,并支持随后的GPRO培训管道.

blocks.en: A.2.2 Details about the Rollout Process
blocks.zh: 第A.2.2号决定 关于推出进程的细节

blocks.en: SFT initializes the audiovisual captioning format of the model and enables preliminary event alignment capabilities. For GRPO, we first conduct the rollout process to identify qualified videos and yield high-quality event-level supervision signals. We perform rollout on the videos selected in Sec. A.2.1 , all equipped with the well-constructed reference structures (i.e., sets of audiovisual event units and audio-to-visual synchronization queries). Each selected video is then inferred 8 times (i.e., group size) using the SFT model.
blocks.zh: SFT初始化了该模型的视听字幕格式,并实现了初步事件对齐能力. 对GRPO来说,我们首先开展推出进程,以查明合格的视频,并产生高质量的事件层面监督信号。 我们在Sec.A.2.1中选定的视频上展开,这些视频都配备了精心构建的参考结构(即成套视听活动单元和视听同步查询)。 然后使用SFT模型推断出每段选定的视频8次(即组大小).

blocks.en:
Leveraging the constructed reference structures, we compute two types of event-level rewards for each generated caption during the rollout process: the intra-event attribution reward and the inter-event synchronization reward.
Specifically, the intra-event attribution reward focuses on evaluating the proportion of events that are correctly attributed to the appropriate characters, while the inter-event synchronization reward quantifies the alignment between audio events and the constructed candidate visual events by calculating the F1-score.
blocks.zh:
我们利用已构建的参考结构,计算出在推出过程中每个生成的字幕的两类事件级奖励:事件内归属奖励和事件间同步奖励.
具体来说,事件内部的归属奖励侧重于评价正确归属于适当字符的事件比例,而事件间同步奖励则通过计算F1-分数来量化音频事件与构建中候选视觉事件之间的对齐.

blocks.en:
To ensure the quality of supervision signals for subsequent preference training, we implement a two-stage filtering mechanism at the query level and the video level. At the query level, invalid audio-to-visual synchronization queries are filtered by the inter-event synchronization reward. Specifically, we aggregate reward values for each individual query across the 8 generated captions, and retain only queries whose average synchronization reward falls within the interval ( 0 , 0.75 ) (0,0.75) , following the filtering protocol of HumanOmniV2 [ 49 ] .
At the video level, filtering is performed based on the sum of intra-event attribution reward and inter-event synchronization reward. We first eliminate videos with fewer than 5 valid synchronization queries, as such cases lack sufficient synchronized semantic information to support reliable training. We then compute the standard deviation of the combined reward scores across the 8 generated captions per video, and finally retain the top 50% of qualified videos, yielding 3.2K valid video samples for downstream GRPO training.
blocks.zh:
为确保后续优惠培训的监督信号质量,我们在查询和视频层面实行两阶段过滤机制。 在查询层面,无效的视听同步查询通过事件间同步奖励进行过滤. 具体地说,我们按照HumanOmniV2的过滤协议,在8个生成的字幕中汇总每个单个查询的奖励值,只保留其平均同步奖励在间隔(0,0.75)范围内的查询(0,0.75).
在视频层面,过滤根据事件内部归属奖励和事件间同步奖励的总和进行. 我们首先删除少于5个有效同步查询的视频,因为此类案件缺乏足够的同步语义信息来支持可靠的培训. 然后计算每个视频8个生成的字幕的综合奖励分数的标准偏差, 最后保留了最高50%的合格视频,

blocks.en: We conduct two rounds of GRPO training, with one training epoch set for each round. In the first round, we only leverage Global Event Completeness and Inter-Event Synchronization for model optimization. Accordingly, the rollout video selection relies solely on the standard deviation of the inter-event synchronization reward. In the second round, we incorporate all three designed reward components into the joint training objective. Correspondingly, the rollout selection strategy is updated to adopt the standard deviation of the sum of inter-event synchronization reward and intra-event attribution reward as the screening criterion.
blocks.zh: 我们进行两轮GRPO培训,每轮培训设定一个培训日期。 在第一轮,我们只利用全球事件完整性和跨事件同步来优化模型。 因此,推出视频选择完全依赖于事件间同步奖励的标准偏差. 在第二轮中,我们将所有三个设计的奖励部分纳入联合培训目标。 相应的,推出选择策略更新,采用活动间同步奖励和活动内归属奖励的总和的标准偏差作为筛选标准.

blocks.en: A.3 Additional Experiment Results
blocks.zh: A.3 其他实验结果

blocks.en: To ensure testing efficiency, we use Qwen3.5-27B [ 33 ] instead of Gemini-2.5-Pro [ 8 ] and Seed-1.6 [ 31 ] as the judge LLM for event-centric evaluation in the experiments in this section. Additionally, we halve the GRPO training process, retaining only 1.6K video samples after rollout.
blocks.zh: 为了确保测试效率,我们使用Quen3.5-27B[33]代替双子座-2.5-Pro[8]和种子1.6[31]作为本节实验中以事件为中心的评价的LLM法官. 此外,我们把GRPO培训进程减半,在推出后只保留了1.6K视频样本。

blocks.en: A.3.1 Ablation on the Independent Effect of Data and Reward
blocks.zh: A.3.1 关于数据的独立影响和报酬的规定

blocks.en: In Sec. 4.3 , we conduct thorough ablation experiments on our post-training pipeline. To clearly disentangle gains from constructed data versus reward guidance, we decouple the data and reward suites to evaluate each contribution to performance.
blocks.zh: 第4.3节,我们在训练后的管道上进行彻底的消毒试验。 为了明确区分构建数据的收益与奖励指导,我们将数据与奖励套件脱钩,以评估对业绩的每一贡献。

blocks.en: Data Effect. To separate the contribution of EVA-Data from the GRPO process, we compare SFT on EVA-Data with SFT on a same-size subset (63K) sampled from ASID-1M [ 19 ] , which lacks event-centric quality control.
blocks.zh: 数据效应. 为了将EVA-Data的贡献与GRPO进程区分开来,我们将EVA-Data上的SFT与从ASID-1M[19]中抽取的相同大小子集(63K)上的SFT进行比较,后者缺乏以事件为中心的质量控制.

blocks.en: As shown in Tab. 5 , replacing the SFT data with event-centric refined data improves both event-oriented and general performance, e.g., by +4.9% on A2V grounding and +3.6% on Daily-Omni. This demonstrates the effectiveness of our data construction pipeline and the quality of EVA-Data.
blocks.zh: 如塔布所示. 5,将SFT数据替换为以事件为中心的精细数据,既能改善面向事件的表现,又能改善一般表现,例如A2V地面定位为+4.9%,Daily-Omni为+3.6%. 这表明我们的数据建设管道的有效性和EVA-Data的质量。

blocks.en: Reward Effect. To test whether our event-centric reward framework generalizes beyond EVA-Data, we apply the same training recipe to a different publicly available model, ASID-Captioner [ 19 ] . Specifically, we use its released SFT model as the baseline and then perform two stages of GRPO training on the publicly available ASID-1M dataset, using the same reward suite we proposed.
blocks.zh: 报应效应. 为了检验我们以事件为中心的奖励框架是否超越了EVA-Data,我们把同样的培训方法应用于不同的公开模式——ASID-Capitioner[19]. 具体地说,我们使用其发布的SFT模型作为基线,然后使用我们提议的同样的奖励套件,对公开的ASID-1M数据集进行两个阶段的GPRO培训。

blocks.en: These results in Tab. 6 show that, independent of EVA-Data, our event-centric framework can be effectively applied to another publicly available SFT model and yields consistent improvements across both event-centric and general benchmarks. This supports the generalizability of the reward framework and, together with the ablation in Tab. 5 , further demonstrates that the final gains come from both the event-centric data and the framework.

blocks.en: A.3.2 Robustness of the Reward Judge
blocks.zh: A.3.2 奖励法官的实力

blocks.en: We assess the robustness of the reward judge in two ways. First, before selecting Qwen3.5-27B as the reward LLM, we sampled 200 reward-evaluation items covering the three reward dimensions and compared its judgments against Gemini-2.5-Pro. The agreement rate is around 85%, suggesting that Qwen3.5-27B provides reliable event-level judgments for reward supervision without obvious systematic bias.
blocks.zh: 我们以两种方式评估奖励法官的实力。 首先,在选择Qwen3.5-27B作为奖励LLM之前,我们抽样了200个奖励评价项目,涉及三个奖励方面,并将其判决与双子座-2.5-Pro进行比较. 协议率约为85%,表明Quen3.5-27B为奖励监督提供了可靠的事件级判断,没有明显的系统性偏见.

blocks.en: Second, we also replace Qwen3.5-27B with the open-source Gemma-4-31B-it [ 32 ] as the reward judge to further test training stability under different judges. We perform GRPO training (stage 1) using the same reward design (Global Event Completeness and Inter-Event Synchronization).
blocks.zh: 其次,我们还用开源的Gemma-4-31B-it[32]取代Quen3.5-27B作为奖励法官,在不同的法官之下进一步测试培训稳定性. 我们使用同样的奖励设计(全球事件完整性和企业间同步)进行GPRO培训(第1阶段)。

blocks.en: As shown in Tab. 7 , under supervision from the Global Event Completeness and Inter-Event Synchronization rewards, both reward judges lead to similar and consistent improvements over SFT across event-centric and general benchmarks. This suggests that our reward design and training framework are robust to the choice of reward LLM, and that EVA-Cap learns fundamental event-centric alignment rather than merely exploiting the preferences of a specific judge.
blocks.zh: 如塔布所示. 7,在全球事件完整性和事件间同步奖励的监督下,两个奖励法官都比SFT在以事件为中心的一般基准方面有类似和一致的改进。 这表明我们的奖励设计和培训框架对于奖励LLM的选择是强有力的,而且EVA-Cap学会了以事件为中心的基本协调,而不仅仅是利用特定法官的偏好。

blocks.zh: A.3.3 长效控制幻觉评价

blocks.en: All models in our evaluation use the same maximum generation length of 2048. For length-controlled evaluation, we split video-SALMONN2 testset [ 29 ] predictions by token length into [0, 700), [700, 1000), and [1000, 2048], and recompute the hallucination rate within each partition.

blocks.en: Under this length-matched comparison, EVA-Cap shows lower hallucination than DiaDem in the short-length and mid-length splits, while DiaDem is lower in the longest split. This suggests that EVA-Cap is more reliable when producing compact, event-centric audiovisual captions, but still lags behind strong baselines on long-form outputs. We will further study the trade-off between detail and hallucination in future work.
blocks.zh: 在这种长度匹配的比较下,EVA-Cap在短长和中长分裂中显示的幻觉比DiaDem低,而DiaDem在最长分裂中显示的幻觉比DiaDem低. 这表明,EVA-Cap在制作紧凑、以事件为中心的视听字幕时更加可靠,但仍落后于长式产出的有力基线。 我们将在今后的工作中进一步研究细节与幻觉之间的权衡。

blocks.en: A.3.4 Experiments with Event Precision Reward
blocks.zh: A.3.4 事件精确奖励实验

blocks.en: The Global Event Completeness reward ℛ comp \mathcal{R}_{\mathrm{comp}} encourages more detailed captions. After GRPO training with ℛ comp \mathcal{R}_{\mathrm{comp}} , the average caption length on video-SALMONN2 testset increases from 633.0 tokens (SFT) to 748.2 tokens. However, the per-token hallucination rate does not increase (8.2 → 8.1 Hall./1k tokens), while event coverage is substantially improved. This suggests that the higher absolute hallucination rate is largely coupled with longer, more comprehensive descriptions, rather than a pure collapse into unfaithful verbosity.
blocks.zh: 全球事件完整性奖励 R comp \ mathcal{ R}_{\ mathrm{ comp} 鼓励更详细的标题 。 在使用 R comp \ mathcal{ R}_{\ mathrm{ comp} 进行 GRPO 训练后, 视频- SALMONN2 测试集的平均标题长度从 633. 0 个令牌( SFT) 增加到 748. 2 个令牌 。 然而,每张电话的幻觉率并没有增加(8.2 ~ 8.1 Hall./1k 令牌),而事件覆盖面则大为改善。 这表明更高的绝对幻觉率在很大程度上与更长,更全面的描述相配合,而不是纯粹的崩溃成不忠的动词.

blocks.en: Furthermore, we add an event-level precision term to the recall-based GRPO baseline, which is computed by decomposing the predicted caption into a sequence of audiovisual events and then determining the proportion of these events that are entailed in the groundtruth caption.
blocks.zh: 此外,我们在基于召回的GRPO基线中增加了一个事件级精准术语,通过将预测的字幕分解成一系列视听事件,然后确定这些活动在地面真实字幕中所占的比例来计算。

blocks.zh: 表9:业绩与事件精确奖励的比较。

blocks.en: Adding precision shortens captions and reduces absolute hallucination, but increases the miss rate, slightly hurts general performance, and does not improve length-normalized faithfulness (Hall./1k: 8.1 → 8.9), while raising training cost due to extra judge calls. This indicates that precision can be viewed as encouraging more conservative outputs. In contrast, our Intra-Event Attribution reward ℛ attr \mathcal{R}_{\mathrm{attr}} already penalizes hallucinated or incorrectly grounded event content, providing a more targeted improvement in faithfulness. We therefore do not include precision/F1 in our reward suite.
blocks.zh: 添加精度会缩短字幕,减少绝对的幻觉,但会提高误差率,略微伤害一般性能,不会提高长度正常的忠诚度(Hall./1k:8.1~8.9),同时由于法官外调而提高培训成本. 这表明精确性可被视为鼓励更保守的产出。 反之,我们的Intra-Event Attribution奖励R attr \ mathcal{R}_{\ mathrm{atr}}}已经惩罚了幻觉或错误地基于事件的内容,为忠诚提供了更有针对性的改进. 因此,我们不把精确度/F1列入我们的奖励套间。

blocks.en: A.4 Discussion with Recent Work
blocks.zh: A.4 与近期工作的讨论

blocks.en: Recent studies [ 24 , 6 , 42 , 25 ] shift caption supervision from a holistic level to fine-grained instance and event levels. Here, we focus on three concurrent works highly relevant to our own: OmniCapBench [ 50 ] , TCA-Captioner [ 59 ] , and AVSCap [ 41 ] . Targeting fine-grained audiovisual captioning, OmniCapBench formalizes video content into a structured representation and employs three interdependent tracks (i.e., references, events, and shots) to evaluate whether a predicted event occurs at the correct time and links to the appropriate visual entities. TCA-Captioner emphasizes temporal and cross-modal alignment, binding auditory events to visual entities and capturing complex causal dynamics through data construction and SFT training. AVSCap achieves explicit cross-modal event binding through a designed reward, focusing on whether the caption captures temporally synchronized audiovisual events.
blocks.zh: 最近的研究[24、6、42、25] 将标题监督从整体层面转向精细实例和事件层面。 在这里,我们着重讨论与我们自己密切相关的三项并行工作:Omni Cap Bench [50]、TCA-Captioner [59]和AVSCap [41]。 OmniCap Bench将视频内容正规化,成为结构化的代表,并使用三个相互依存的音轨(例如参考、事件和镜头)来评价预测的事件是否在正确的时间发生并与适当的视觉实体连接。 TCA-Capitioner强调时间和跨模式对接,将听觉事件绑定在视觉实体身上,并通过数据构建和SFT培训捕捉复杂的因果动态. AVSCAP通过设计奖励实现明确的交叉模式活动绑定,重点是标题是否包含时间同步的视听事件.

blocks.en:
While our EVA-Cap shares the same objectives as these studies, we emphasize comprehensive, fine-grained, event-centric caption optimization and offer a distinct solution.
Although the data curation pipelines differ in detail, they all achieve high-fidelity caption annotation, providing diverse options for data scaling. Methodologically, the reward design in AVSCap is closely related to our approach, paralleling the mechanism employed in our Stage 3 annotation pipeline. A key distinction in reward design is that we decouple audio and visual events for calculation during the GRPO process, whereas AVSCap treats synchronized audiovisual events as a unified whole. We leave the experimental comparison of these design choices, as well as the exploration of data mixing and methodological integration, for future work.
blocks.zh:
虽然我们的EVA-Cap与这些研究的目标相同,但我们强调全面、精细、以事件为中心的标题优化,并提出一个独特的解决办法。
尽管数据解析管道在细节上有所不同,但它们都实现了高真实性标题注释,为数据缩放提供了多种选项. 从方法上讲,AVSCap中的奖励设计与我们的方法密切相关,与我们第三阶段注解管道所采用的机制是平行的。 奖励设计中的一个关键区别是,我们在GRPO进程期间将音频和视觉事件解析为计算,而AVSCap则将同步视听事件作为一个统一的整体处理. 我们把这些设计选择的试验性比较以及数据混合和方法整合的探索留给今后工作。

blocks.en: A.5 Failure Cases and Limitations
blocks.zh: A.5 失败案件和限制

blocks.en: As shown in Fig. 6 , we summarize two common failure modes of EVA-Cap: 1) In videos with rapid scene transitions, omissions in visual descriptions and misalignment between audio and visual descriptions still tend to occur. 2) In multi-character scenes with off-screen speech, the speaker identity is also prone to being incorrectly bound. This issue likely arises from limitations in understanding instances and capturing key information in complex, dynamic scenes. We intend to mitigate this limitation in future work by introducing grounded audiovisual captioning, to further enhance the fidelity and trustworthiness of audiovisual captioning by binding audio and visual cues to specific instances in space and time.
blocks.zh: 如图6所示,我们总结了EVA-Cap的两个常见故障模式: 1)在场景过渡迅速的视频中,视觉描述中的遗漏和音频与视觉描述的错配仍然有发生的趋势. 2)在带有外屏演讲的多特征场景中,扬声器身份也容易受到不正确的约束. 这个问题可能源于在复杂和动态场景中理解事例和获取关键信息方面的局限性。 我们打算在今后的工作中减少这一限制,采用有底线的视听字幕,通过将视听提示与空间和时间的具体情况挂钩,进一步提高视听字幕的可靠性和可信度。

blocks.en: Although EVA-Data is constructed via a multi-stage pipeline (initialization–revision–filtering) that enables scalable annotation, it still relies on proprietary MLLMs for caption generation and quality control. This dependence may introduce biases from proprietary teachers and leave residual annotation errors after automatic verification. In the future, we plan to improve this pipeline by integrating agent-based, multi-level cross-verification: multiple models and rule-based checkers cross-validate captions and events at fine granularity, recursively refine inconsistent annotations, and reject insufficiently verified samples, thereby improving annotation fidelity while reducing dependence on single models.
blocks.zh: 虽然EVA-Data是通过多阶段管道(初始化-Review-filtering)构建的,该管道可以进行可扩展的注释,但它仍然依赖于专有的MLLMs来进行字幕生成和质量控制. 这种依赖性可能带来专有教师的偏见,在自动核实后留下剩余的注释错误。 今后,我们计划通过整合基于代理,多层次的交叉验证来改进这一管道:多模型和基于规则的检查器在细颗粒化时交叉验证标题和事件,递归完善不一致的说明,并拒绝未经充分验证的样本,从而改善注释的忠实性,同时减少对单一模型的依赖性.

blocks.en: A.7 Broader Impact
blocks.zh: A.7 更广泛的影响

blocks.en: EVA-Cap aims to advance audiovisual video captioning by generating more faithful, comprehensive, and temporally coherent descriptions of videos. This can benefit various downstream applications that rely on detailed and accurate video understanding. Better alignment between audio and visual events may help reduce misleading descriptions in scenarios where both modalities are necessary for understanding the video content.
blocks.zh: EVA-Cap旨在通过制作更忠实、全面和时间上一致的视频描述来推进视听视频字幕。 这有利于依赖详细准确的视频理解的各种下游应用. 音频和视觉事件之间更好地保持一致,可能有助于减少在两种模式对理解视频内容均有必要的情况下的误导性描述。

blocks.en: At the same time, improved audiovisual captioning systems may introduce potential risks if deployed without appropriate safeguards. First, generated captions may still contain omissions, hallucinations, incorrect speaker attributions, or inaccurate audio-visual temporal relations. Such errors could mislead users if the captions are treated as factual summaries. Second, automatic captioning of user-generated videos may raise privacy concerns when videos contain identifiable people, sensitive conversations, or private environments. Third, high-quality video descriptions could be misused for large-scale surveillance, profiling, or automated indexing of sensitive content.
blocks.zh: 与此同时,改进视听字幕系统,如果没有适当的保障措施,可能会带来潜在风险。 首先,生成的字幕可能仍然含有遗漏、幻觉、不正确的扬声器属性或不准确的视听时间关系。 如果将标题视为事实摘要,这种错误可能会误导用户。 其次,当视频包含可识别的人、敏感对话或私人环境时,用户制作的视频的自动字幕可能会引起隐私问题。 第三,高质量的视频描述可能被滥用,用于大规模监视、剖析或对敏感内容进行自动索引。
